title: What kind of country (identity carousel)
hook: people ask what kind of country i play.
body:
grew up on waylon and merle. mostly i just try to write true ones and sing em like i mean it.

[BEN: one line in your own words about your sound, if you want]

glad you're here.
media_notes: Lead slide is the card. Add 2 to 4 photos (portrait, on stage, the band) as the rest of the carousel.
